title: Regular-sequence presentation of a principal localization of a domain polynomial quotient
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $n\geq 0$, and $f=(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$ a regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] in $R=k[X_1,\ldots,X_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Suppose $A=R/(f)$ is a domain and $0\ne g\in A$. Then there is a regular sequence $q$ of length $c+1$ in $k[X_1,\ldots,X_{n+1}]$ whose quotient is isomorphic as a $k$-algebra to the principal localization $A[1/g]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away].

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma 00SA (lemma-localize-lci), displayed polynomial presentation; regularity checked as in the proof of 07BV (lemma-colimit-syntomic).

proof.text: Lift g to h in R, and set S=R[T], fs to the constant-polynomial images of f, t=hT-1, and Q=(fs). The quotient S/Q is A[T] by Mathlib MvPolynomial.quotientEquivQuotientMvPolynomial. The image of t is gT-1. The double-quotient isomorphism identifies S/(fs,t) with A[T]/(gT-1), which is A[1/g] by [lem-weil-pbc-localization-away-polynomial-quotient].

source.place: Algebra, proof of Lemma 00SA (lemma-localize-lci), displayed polynomial presentation; regularity checked as in the proof of 07BV (lemma-colimit-syntomic).

proof.text: The R-module R[T] is free, hence flat. Mathlib IsWeaklyRegular.of_flat makes fs weakly regular. In S/Q=A[T], gT-1 has constant coefficient -1, so is nonzero; A[T] is a domain, so multiplication by it is injective. Transport this cancellation across the quotient isomorphism and apply isWeaklyRegular_append_iff to fs followed by t.

proof.text: The map A to A[1/g] is injective because g is nonzero and A is a domain. Thus A[1/g] is nonzero. The presentation isomorphism shows the ideal (fs,t) is proper, establishing the nonzero final quotient required for a regular sequence.

lean.statement: theorem exists_localizationAway_presentation (k : Type u) [Field k] (n : ℕ) (f : List (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k)) (hf : IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k) f) [IsDomain (MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ Ideal.ofList f)] (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) k ⧸ Ideal.ofList f) (hg : g ≠ 0) : ∃ q : List (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k), q.length = f.length + 1 ∧ IsRegular (MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) q ∧ Nonempty ((MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k ⧸ Ideal.ofList q) ≃ₐ[k] Localization.Away g)
